text.description_html:
Solid Cast Brass Victorian Style Door Push Plate 3" Wide x 15" High

Victorian style push plate done in the Rococo style first popular in France c. 1730's and spreading over Europe during the Victorian era. The Rococo style often embraced three dimensional mirrored finishes, combined with a whimsical combination of shells, flowers, ribbons and reeds.

Brass Accents provides distinctive craftsmanship with old-world tradition for a lifetime of elegance. Their products are hand finished in the USA. They are one of the worlds leading crafters of cast-brass and hot-forged decorative brass hardware.

The flat surface of the victorian push plate (inside the ornate pattern on the edges) measures 2" wide x 9-3/4" high. Packaged with matching finish mounting screws.

Specifications for Brass Accents A05-P4450 Victorian Door Push Plate

  • Plate Width: 3-1/4"
  • Plate Height: 15"
  • Flat Surface: 2" x 9-3/4"
  • Material: Cast Brass

Comes complete with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation. Hand rubbed and finished in the USA.
